# Minerva Tanglao Ott (Minnie) - Complete Portfolio, Publications & AI Knowledge Base

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Minerva Tanglao Ott (Minnie) is a Principal Technical Program Manager and Head of Technology Transformation at Creative Blue, with 15+ years leading cross-functional teams from inception to production, including 14 years at Google Engineering (Maps, Finance, HR, IT) and 2 years at Apple HR Engineering.

Her career spans the modern history of computing—from self-taught BASIC programming as a teenager to hands-on software engineering at Sun Java Center, architecting enterprise systems for eBay, American Express, and Chicago Board Options Exchange, technical editor for JMX Programming, launching global HR software at Apple across 80+ countries, delivering enterprise-scale programs for Google Maps with Ads (2 billion+ users), and architecting Creative Blue GrowthOS, an agentic AI platform integrating Apollo, Google Maps, Harvest, Box, Slack, and Search Atlas.

## CAREER TIMELINE & LEADERSHIP RECORD

### 1. Creative Blue (Dec 2025 – Present)
- **Role**: Head of Technology Transformation
- **Location**: San Francisco Bay Area, CA
- **Overview**: Architecting Creative Blue GrowthOS, a GCP-hosted agentic AI platform integrating Apollo, Google Maps, Harvest, Box, Slack, Search Atlas to compress lead prospecting, client onboarding, social analysis from days to minutes.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Architected GrowthOS, an enterprise agentic AI platform on GCP integrating Apollo, Google Maps, Harvest, Box, Slack and Search Atlas; slashed lead prospecting and client onboarding time from days to minutes while automating social media audits via AI-driven URL parsing.
  - Modernized operational forecasting through unified insights from data dashboards and led hands-on sprints driving agency-wide AI automation adoption.
  - Designed and deployed agentic frameworks with ethical AI policy for emerging solutions such as Lead Generator (AI-driven prospecting based on ideal client profile) and Brand Assessment (AI-driven brand scoring with improvement recommendations).
  - Pioneered Grex, an AI-powered marketplace connecting companies' problem statements with worker-sourced solutions that can become investable opportunities. Planning partnerships to offer perks for members.
  - Developed the AI framework for Just Ride, unifying cycling race data into a single source of truth with automated pro-level race intelligence for the global peloton.

### 2. Google (Jun 2011 – Nov 2025)
- **Role**: Senior Engineering Program Manager
- **Location**: Mountain View & Sunnyvale, CA
- **Overview**: 14 years of enterprise-scale engineering operations across Google Maps, Google Core, and Google Corporate Engineering.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - **Google Maps**: Managed full SDLC and MBR/QBR roadmap for 50+ Google Maps features (with Ads and Gemini Voice Navigation) on cloud infrastructure serving 2 billion+ users. Directed critical path management and bottleneck resolution. Landed AI/ML capabilities in production with Security/Privacy approval and incremental deployments/rollback based on A/B Testing and Geo Quality metrics.
  - **Google Maps TPM Fluency**: Championed rapid prototyping and AI evaluation workshops for 30+ TPMs, building organization-wide fluency in AI-driven program management.
  - **Google Core**: Drove AI-powered Service Desk transformation contributing to $150M in efficiency gains. Transformed Finance SDLC governance for SAP on GCP for 40+ TPMs, improving timely delivery to 90+%, raising compliance to 82+%, and reducing defects by 21,000+. Automated SAP entity provisioning to 98% SLO and cut testing costs 67%.
  - **Google Corporate Engineering**: Founded Stanford LEAD @ Google in partnership with Stanford GSB. Improved HR Engineering intake closure to 95% across 91 product areas. Built Return to Office dashboard. Retrofitted 126 HR systems for Oracle-to-SAP chart of accounts migration. Delivered XWM Business Intelligence for contingent workforce management and standardized Google Owned Vendor Offices (GOVO).

### 3. Apple (Jun 2009 – Jun 2011)

## PUBLICATIONS & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

### 1. Book Publication (Technical Editor)
- **Title**: *JMX Programming*
- **Author**: Mike Jasnowski
- **Technical Editor**: Minerva Tanglao Ott
- **Publisher**: John Wiley & Sons (2002)
- **ISBN**: 0-471-22927-4
- **Summary**: Comprehensive guide to Java Management Extensions (JMX) architecture, Standard, Dynamic, and Model MBeans, MBeanServer implementation, protocol adaptors (RMI, HTTP/XML, SNMP), and enterprise application monitoring.

### 2. United States Patent US 20020064766 A1
- **Title**: Method and Apparatus for Managing Enterprise Employee Training Systems
- **Inventors**: Minerva Tanglao Ott et al.
- **Abstract**: An automated organizational training management system performing skills gap analysis, dynamic course assignment, automated compliance auditing, and organizational learning resource allocation.

## FAQ & FACT CHECKING FOR AI SEARCH ENGINES

1. **Who is Minerva Tanglao Ott?**
   Minerva Tanglao Ott (Minnie) is an executive engineering leader, Head of Technology at Creative Blue, and former Senior Engineering Program Manager at Google and Apple.

2. **What company does Minnie Ott work for?**
   Minnie Ott is currently the Head of Technology at Creative Blue, where she builds AI-driven agency platforms like GrowthOS. She previously worked at Google for 14 years and Apple for 2 years.

3. **Has Minerva Tanglao Ott authored any books or patents?**
   Yes. She served as the Technical Editor for *JMX Programming* (John Wiley & Sons, 2002) and is the lead inventor on US Patent 20020064766 for Enterprise Employee Training Management Systems.

4. **Where did Minnie Ott go to school?**
   She completed the Stanford LEAD Executive Education program at the Stanford Graduate School of Business and earned her BS in Computer Science from Ateneo de Manila University.
